question: By what mantra must the wearing of tripuṇḍra on the head be performed?
premises: The prepared ash is to be ritually applied.
The application consists of wearing tripuṇḍra on the head.
This wearing is to be performed with the five-syllable mantra.
inference: Therefore, the ritual wearing of tripuṇḍra on the head must be carried out using the five-syllable mantra.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the pañcākṣara mantra is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: One should also apply the tripuṇḍra on the head using the five-syllable mantra.
